refs.label: Charm headline card
refs.structure: Sky-blue ground with one large organic blob sweeping the top; centered white rounded card holding a two-line bold headline; dark CTA pill under the headline; wordmark bottom-left; four small check-mark feature labels bottom-right; two playful sticker charms overlapping the card's top-right corner.

refs.label: Stat headline card
refs.structure: Deep navy ground with a huge light-blue blob behind a white rounded card; card carries a big statistic-led headline ('93% of customers say…') with an asterisk; small dark CTA pill bottom-left inside the card; playful accent shapes at the card's lower-right; wordmark bottom-left, legal line bottom-right.

refs.label: Coach card + charms
refs.structure: Two-tone blue ground (dark blob top, light below); white rounded card with a stacked two-line headline in heavy type; dark CTA pill; two speech-bubble charms peeking over the card's top edge; wordmark bottom-left with a four-item green-tick feature row beside it.

refs.label: Photo + card overlay
refs.structure: Warm lifestyle photo (two people talking at a desk) fills the frame; a white rounded speech-bubble card occupies the top half with a bold two-line headline and a light-blue CTA pill; wordmark sits mid-right over the photo; a small sticker charm floats between card and photo.

refs.label: Photo hero + blob footer
refs.structure: Top half is a candid photo of a person using a phone; a huge brand-blue blob sweeps the lower half carrying a bold white headline at top-left of frame; light CTA pill bottom-left; white wordmark bottom-right inside the blob; one green-tick charm accent over the photo.

refs.label: Split comparison
refs.structure: Vertical split: left third is a dark navy wave panel with a white pain-point headline ('Other software holds you back'); right side light-blue with the benefit headline in navy; a hand holding a phone with the product UI rises from the bottom centre; four green-tick feature labels bottom-left; wordmark bottom-left, white CTA pill bottom-right; small heart charm accent.

refs.label: Headline card A
refs.structure: Brand-blue ground, white rounded card centred with a confident two-line headline, dark CTA pill, wordmark bottom-left, one sticker charm overlapping the card edge.

refs.label: Headline card B
refs.structure: Light ground with one large brand-colour blob; white card with bold headline and CTA pill; green-tick feature row; wordmark bottom-left; playful charm accent top-right.

refs.label: Feature promo card
refs.structure: Two-tone brand ground; white rounded card with eyebrow line, big headline, short body line and CTA pill; three-item green-tick feature list; wordmark bottom-left; charm accents around the card.

refs.label: Photo + benefit stack
refs.structure: Lifestyle photo on one half, flat brand-colour panel on the other carrying headline, body line, tick features and CTA pill; wordmark anchored in a corner; one blob bridges photo and panel.
